resources.string: Accessibility nodes are the default. After you enable visual mode and grant system consent, AI captures only on an observation request and sends a temporary image to your current local model provider; no continuous uploads. Login, password, OTP, payment, protected and ambiguous screens are refused. Images stay out of history and exports. Task completion, stop, lock or grant revocation ends the session; a fresh grant is required next time. Complete image-only targets manually when safe semantic actions are unavailable.
First enable phone control in the conversation panel with Full or AutoReview and an OpenAI-compatible provider.
